2026_02_PHI_TEN.headline: Philadelphia’s front meets Tennessee’s young offense with Carter playing hurt
2026_02_PHI_TEN.paragraph1: Philadelphia travels to Nashville with Jalen Carter expected to play through a wrist injury in a cast, while the Eagles also face the challenge of containing Jeffery Simmons after losing guard Landon Dickerson. Tennessee needs Cam Ward to avoid the obvious passing situations that let Vic Fangio disguise coverage and pressure. The Eagles can control the matchup if their protection handles Simmons and their defense keeps Ward behind schedule; the Titans need their front to disrupt Jalen Hurts before Philadelphia’s balance takes over.
2026_02_PHI_TEN.model_rationale: Protection on both sides is central: Tennessee must keep Cam Ward out of predictable passing downs, while Philadelphia has to contain Jeffery Simmons and preserve offensive balance.
